# SDLC2 Templates

These blank forms are reusable formats, not approved scope or evidence.
Copy a template into its indicated lifecycle area and replace placeholders with grounded content.
Keep decision documents within 50 physical lines; split focused concerns as needed.
Draft Tasks only after the Sprint Plan is approved.
Record actual approval by commit and separate execution authorization; never use reviewer initials.
